title: Thiols, sulfides and disulfides
caption: Sulfur sits below oxygen in group 16, giving thiols (R–SH), sulfides (R–S–R) and disulfides (R–S–S–R). Thiols smell strongly. Two cysteine thiols can be oxidised to a disulfide bridge, which holds protein chains in shape.
alt: Ethanethiol, dimethyl sulfide and dimethyl disulfide.
description: Dimethyl disulfide, CH₃SSCH₃: the S–S link.
